description: London Heathrow Airport. PROVISIONAL DRAFT 24-10-2026: coordinates and elevation (83 ft) are from public aggregator sites, not checked against the UK AIP. Heathrow has two parallel runways on the 09/27 alignment (09L/27R and 09R/27L); the owner's priorities did not name a side, so following the same convention as Tamworth (YSTW) and Dublin (EIDW), this pack models 09/27 as a single runway without an L/R suffix. Other simulation assumptions carry over from the Australian packs.
name: Heathrow
